description: This file defines a class SawOscillatorDPW which extends the SawOscillator class to implement a band-limited sawtooth oscillator with delta-pulse width modulation (DPW). It contains methods to set frequency and generate the oscillator waveform, applying a smoothing filter to reduce aliasing at high frequencies.

classes.name: SawOscillatorDPW
classes.description: A band-limited sawtooth oscillator with DPW implementation, designed to minimize aliasing at high frequencies.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Calculates and sets the oscillator's frequency-dependent scaler based on the input frequency, ensuring stability at very low frequencies.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the next sample of the oscillator waveform, applying a smoothing filter to reduce aliasing.
